mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressures that may lead to tighter monetary policy, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% does not correlate with negative 20-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, which may lead to wage inflation and subsequent monetary tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE < 4% does not correlate with negative 60-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals a strengthening economy and increased demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST increases do not correlate with positive 5-day forward returns in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% month-over-month signals a weakening supply side of the economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO MoM < -1% does not correlate with negative 20-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases simultaneously, it signals a strong labor market and economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the joint condition does not correlate with positive 20-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 5% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is increasing, it signals a restrictive monetary policy environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the joint condition does not correlate with negative 60-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in real final sales (RSAFS) by more than 1% quarter-over-quarter signals a weakening demand side of the economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS QoQ < -1% does not correlate with negative 20-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) increases by more than 2% year-over-year and GDP (GDPC1) growth is above 3%, it signals a strong supply side and overall economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the joint condition does not correlate with positive 60-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.
